headline: IHSG Strengthens During Session I, Foreigners Buy 10 Stocks Including These
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index closed stronger at 5,228.24 on turnover of Rp6.43 trillion. Foreign investors recorded net selling during the session.
why: The Jakarta Composite is Indonesia's main equity benchmark, and foreign flows are a key gauge of demand for Indonesian stocks.
why_moved: The index closed higher on trading turnover of Rp6.43 trillion, even though foreign investors were net sellers during the session.
original_headline: IHSG Menguat Sepanjang Sesi I, Asing borong 10 Saham Ini
